definition.title: What Is an AI UGC Video Ad Generator?
paras: It is software that turns one product photo and a short scene idea into a finished clip, with the performer, setting and edit produced automatically. Sellers use it to ship feed-ready ads without hiring a creator, booking a studio or learning an editing suite.

steps.d: Use one clear photo with the full item in frame so the product carries into the scene.
Say where the ad happens and what the person does. One focused action keeps the hook easy to follow.
Download the clean clip, then add captions, prices or music in your editor for each channel.

faq.q: What is an AI UGC video ad?
faq.a: It is a short creator-style ad that shows your product in a scene with a spoken line or visible action. The presenter and setting are AI-generated.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or studio?
faq.a: No. Start with one product photo and a focused idea, then make the scene without casting, booking or a studio day.

faq.q: Can I use the ad on TikTok, Reels or Shorts?
faq.a: Yes. Download a 9:16 clip for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts, then add the copy and offer details for that channel.

faq.q: What product photo should I use?
faq.a: Use a clear, well-lit photo with the full product visible and its important details easy to inspect.

faq.q: Can I add captions, prices or music?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact text and licensed music after download in TikTok, CapCut or your ad editor.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives one action a clear beginning and end.

faq.q: How many credits does a video ad cost?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Failed jobs return credits automatically.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is an AI-generated brand performer, not a customer endorsement. Use a factual script and disclose AI content when a platform requires it.
